$comment: Validates per-sheet sprite JSON files produced by the sprite-crop skill. Each file describes one source sprite sheet PNG, its grid geometry, and the entities/animations cropped from it. Forward-compatible: unknown properties are allowed at every level so gameplay metadata (collision_box, hitboxes, markers, ...) can be added later without breaking validation.
title: Sprite Sheet Manifest

file.description: Relative path to the source sheet PNG.

rows.description: Number of rows in the sheet grid.

cols.description: Number of columns in the sheet grid.

original_prompt.description: The image-generation prompt used to create the source sheet.

crop.description: Written by record_crop.py after a crop pass.

frames_dir.description: Directory containing the cropped frame PNGs.

pass.description: Identifier for this crop pass (a temp dir path or a label).

schema_version.description: Future-proofing version tag for the manifest format.

entities.description: One entry per animation row (or spanned group).

row.description: Grid row index, or an array of rows when --span was used.

frames.description: Cropped frames for this animation (populated after cropping).

file.description: Filename of the cropped frame PNG.

row.description: Source grid row of this frame.

col.description: Source grid column of this frame.

bbox.description: Crop bounding box [x, y, w, h] in source-sheet pixels.
